requirements: Milestone 2 Deadline: October 29 The requirements of Milestone 2 include identifying (or creating) the dataset and preparing it for ingestion into the model pipeline. The objective is to ensure that the data is well-understood, reliable, ethically sourced, and suitably structured for the selected problem. Dataset & Data Sources The submission should address the following aspects, as applicable to the project type: Clearly identify and verify data sources. Specify the ownership, format, and usage constraints of the data. Provide a detailed description of the dataset, including: Dataset size Feature distribution Relevant data characteristics Assess dataset quality, accounting for: Missing values Inconsistencies Noise Duplicate entries Evaluate whether the dataset is adequate for the chosen problem. Explore options such as data augmentation or expansion through supplementary datasets where necessary. Dataset Splits Clearly define the strategy used to create the training, validation, and test datasets . Ensure there is no data leakage by checking for overlap across the different splits. Synthetic Data If a synthetic dataset is generated: Provide details of the generation process. Explain and justify the design choices made. Multiple Datasets & Subtasks For models involving subtasks that require different datasets: Clearly explain how connections or alignment between the datasets and tasks will be established. Model-Specific Data Requirements Identify the key dataset requirements necessary for effective model training. Vision-Based Tasks Specify labeling and annotation requirements. Verify the quality and consistency of annotations. RAG-Based Setups Describe document preparation steps. Explore appropriate chunking strategies. Explore suitable vector database options. Speech-Based Tasks Address: Audio quality Transcription alignment Sampling consistency LLM Fine-Tuning Tasks Address: Dataset formatting, such as instruction-response structures Token length considerations Prompt structuring requirements Reproducibility Document all preprocessing and data preparation steps to ensure that the process is reproducible.
